reason: A mobile and desktop remote console for viewing and operating DSH sessions, handling approvals and questions, transferring files, and monitoring gateway and host status over LAN or Tailscale.

summaries.zh: DSH Remote 提供手机和桌面端远程控制台，用于查看会话、处理审批与提问、传输文件以及监控网关和主机状态。
summaries.en: DSH Remote provides mobile and desktop remote consoles for viewing sessions, handling approvals and questions, transferring files, and monitoring gateway and host status.

capabilities: Remote viewing and control of DSH sessions
Uploading and downloading files within configured roots
Running a network gateway for remote clients
Displaying usage, connection, and host status
Sending notifications and performing background polling
